if: a registered person CEASES to pay tax under section 10
then: he is ENTITLED to credit of input tax on inputs held in stock, inputs contained in semi-finished or finished goods held in stock, AND ON CAPITAL GOODS, on the day immediately preceding the date from which he becomes liable to pay tax under section 9 — the credit on capital goods being reduced by such percentage points as may be prescribed
note: Capital goods ARE included here, unlike clauses (a) and (b), but at a reduced amount. The reduction percentage is prescribed and is NOT stated in the Act — from this source it is UNKNOWN. The source is the CGST Act as updated 31-08-2021. UNKNOWN whether a later amendment has changed this provision; later amendments are not held locally.
